title: Producer Jeremy Thomas Dies at 77
content: Thomas was a prolific producer and was perhaps best known for producing The Last Emperor film in 1987, for which he won an Oscar for Best Picture. He served as producer for Takashi Miike 's live-action film of Hiroaki Samura 's Blade of the Immortal manga.
